reviews.text:

You pay money expecting to enjoy a complete movie, but instead you’re left disappointed because the story doesn’t finish properly.

I don’t mind paying for entertainment, but I expect to get what I’m paying for. It’s frustrating to spend money and not be able to enjoy even one complete story.

I’m writing this review to warn other people before they spend their money. Please think twice before paying for this app.

JoyReels should make it clear whether the movies are complete before asking customers to pay.

 Moreover you cannot stack your coins  and save them. I had over 1500coins saved only to open the app the next day and find that 1200 of them had “expired”. Incredibly stupid as I essentially watched the ads for nothing and I now have to start again. 
Plus I notice a lot of the stories on the app are basically the same (same plot lines and characters) with slight changes so while it seems there is lots of choice there actually isn’t.

reviews.title: Stymied by all the glowing reviews
reviews.text:
I am absolutely mystified by the number of glowing reviews, honestly. 

First off, if you’re not a fan of AI art or voiceovers, don’t bother. There are a number of dramas where the voiceovers don’t match the captioning, and the characters voices will not only change from American to British English regularly, they’ll even do it halfway through a sentence! 

A good number of dramas are “ongoing” - aka “never finished” - and there’s no filter for completed vs. ongoing, never mind the fact that there are nearly 20 - yes, 20 - different versions of the same exact drama that only differ in the AI rendering and voices used. Exact. Same. Drama. Right down to character names. 

It’s difficult enough finding good LGBTQ+ short dramas, so I had much higher hopes here. Sadly they were disappointed, since a good 50% of them were … the same exact story at varying stages of completion with different visual renderings. Bummer.

reviews.title: Very Expensive and Extremely Misleading
reviews.text:
VIP is not what you think it is — extremely misleading

I subscribed to JoyReels VIP for €22.99/week because I wanted to watch a 68-episode drama. The VIP offer says “Unlock all series for 7 days”, so I reasonably expected to be able to watch the series without additional charges.

Instead, when I reached episode 46 of 68, I got a pop-up saying:

“Please unlock first! Price: 78 Coins/Bonus”

with a “Top Up” button. I was then offered 2,500 Coins + 750 Bonus for €27.49 just to continue watching.

JoyReels’ own information says that VIP provides unlimited access to “eligible JoyReels dramas” — but they never clearly explain what “eligible” actually means or which episodes are excluded. That crucial information is left vague.

And that’s what makes this feel so deceptive. Everything is worded just vaguely enough to cover themselves: “eligible dramas”, “available unlock methods”, etc. Yet the VIP offer itself says “Unlock all series”. If certain episodes require additional payment, why isn’t that clearly stated before someone subscribes?

I also discovered that JoyReels offers cheaper subscriptions, including €9.99/week, but these options weren’t shown to me in the normal subscription choices. I only found them when I went into my settings to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: How I truly feel
reviews.text:
I really wanted to love this app because the dramas are genuinely great, but the experience has become incredibly frustrating. The coin system is confusing, inconsistent, and honestly feels broken.
Every episode requires a large amount of coins, yet the app’s methods for earning them simply do not work. The “watch ads” option doesn’t show ads at all — it loads random articles. Even after reading them, the app refuses to give the reward and keeps sending you back to “read more.” If the button says watch ad, users expect an actual video ad, not a maze of articles that never count.
The second earning method, watching dramas for a set amount of time, is just as unreliable. I complete the required watch‑time, but the reward never appears. No coins, no bonus, no progress.
It’s extremely disappointing because the content itself is genuinely good, but the reward system makes the app nearly unusable. When both earning methods fail, unlocking episodes becomes a chore instead of entertainment.
At this point, it’s simply not worth the frustration. Apps like RealShort, DramaWaver, GoodShorts, and DramaBox have straightforward, functional systems that actually give the rewards they promise. Until this app fixes its coin system and makes earning bonuses clear and reliable, it’s impossible to recommend.

reviews.title: Story endings are left hanging

There is no more! Zip! Zero! Nada! Does she die? Don’t know. Do they get together? Unknown. Does evil prevail? So it seems. At first I thought it was just a gimmick, a way for the app to get you to continue your subscription while they add additional episodes to the storyline each week. Nope! No such luck. I checked back and the stories remained just as they were—just as frustratingly, annoyingly, and maddeningly cut off as ever. So DON’T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY unless you WANT to get to the end of a video and say, “ Wait! This is it?!?!”

reviews.text:

I waited and waited and received absolutely no response to my refund request. It took roughly a WEEK for JoyReels to finally respond, and when they did, they weren’t even addressing my refund. Instead, they were asking me to review their app.

Are you serious?

I contacted you because I wanted my money back and you ignored the actual issue for an entire week. Now I’m having to go through PayPal to try to resolve something that should have been handled by JoyReels in the first place.

I completely understand that not every refund request is going to be approved, but the absolute bare minimum is responding to your customer and actually addressing their concern. Ignoring a refund request for a week and then sending a generic response asking for an app review is incredibly frustrating and makes me feel like my concern wasn’t taken seriously at all.

Do better. If you’re going to take people’s money, you should at least provide them with timely and meaningful customer support when they have an issue with a purchase.

This app is outrageously expensive and its payment system feels completely deceptive. I purchased a subscription, but after watching only a few episodes, I was told that I did not have enough coins to continue. Then, even after purchasing more coins, they were never enough, and the app kept pushing me to spend more and more money just to finish the same story.
What is the point of paying for a subscription if you still have to keep paying to watch the content? A subscription should give users meaningful access, not serve as an entry fee before demanding endless additional payments.
This feels like a complete rip-off and an abusive business model. Other high-quality apps do not use these kinds of misleading tactics. I am extremely disappointed and angry. I would give JoyReels zero stars if Apple allowed it, but since I have to choose at least one, I am giving it one star.

reviews.title: SUBSCRIPTION SCAM
reviews.text:
Do not, I repeat DO NOT buy a subscription, even just the trial!!
I signed up for the 1 week trial with no ads because they really aren’t “short dramas” when half the time is spent watching ads just to get through a single story…right?
Let me tell you how bad of a decision that was. Not only was I unable to just cancel my subscription, after just 5 days of having it, but I spent almost 3 WEEKS asking for an update on my Support ticket requesting to cancel my subscription. Meanwhile they had no issue charging me every week for the subscription I wanted to cancel. 
After repeated requests to cancel my subscription and being provided a chat bot response that “my ticket has been escalated to their professional customer support team”, so I called my bank to prevent more charges. Since only 1 charge had taken place since my initial cancellation request, my bank simply did a charge back. Waited a few days for any message with updates from their support team…nothing. So 48 hours before the next subscription charge I requested an update on my cancellation request. Again, no update just a chat bot letting me know my ticket was escalated. I let their chat know if they charged me again, my bank would file a fraud claim since I had full record of multiple cancellation requests. 2nd charge hits my bank, they file a fraud claim. Within 24 hours of the fraud claim my subscription is miraculously cancelled, however their Support team never followed up to let me know they had finally resolved

reviews.title: Cancel subscription NOW
reviews.text: Please do not try and get money from me my bank has been told not to pay anything

reviews.title: Beware of Subscriptions!
reviews.text: I decided to try one of their VIP subscriptions, and after a week I realized that aside from the one show that I saw on Facebook there wasn’t anything else I really liked. So I decided to cancel. Boy was that a struggle. Their online technical support was no help, he kept giving me the wrong information and then told me that it was a one time payment and I wouldn’t be billed again even through the app had subscription in effect under my name. I finally had to go into my PayPal account reported them as a problem and tell them to stop paying it because they made it so you can’t actually cancel from them. Thankfully, I knew how to do something like that. Otherwise I’d still be paying for an app I don’t wanna pay for anymore because there was only one good show on it.

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text:
In the beginning, the stories, of course come out with a very interesting plot and theme and they really hook you on you feel like you’re reading some sort of a romantic or thriller book and even perhaps watching a movie of that sort. However, it continues to ask for more money for money to continue to watch and then more money to continue to watch and there are absolutely too many ads. This is when I got very disappointed and upset because I realized that I had spent $50 in a matter of two hours.

I will not recommend this application to anyone! ☹️👎🏼

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text: Like other reviews I was charged per so many shorts. I thought I was paying for an entire week. So I tried to cancel but for some crazy reason I couldn’t find where to. When I couldn’t cancel the subscription I went to the help chat. I was continually told someone would be right with me.  Mean time I was charged again and no one was responding to my chat. I would wait 30 min at a time. No one was getting back to me. I finally found the cancellation on my own and did just that but since I wasn’t getting my refund I used up my money and no one ever got back to me. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Canceling nightmare
reviews.text: I purchased a one time use and was charged $20 weekly!!! I couldn’t even watch one show without having ads. I attempted to reach out twice through their app to cancel. After staring and waiting at my app for response for over 30 minutes, I could not walk away because there’s no notification that I received a response. They completely ignored me after saying they were going to.” transfer me to a specialist.” The bot Jack told me there was no phone to call, but I can email them to request a cancellation. I emailed them and it’s been two weeks and I still have not received a response. I had to complete a charge back in order to receive my funds back. This is the worst canceling experience I have ever had.  I believe that they make you wait so you give up and they can keep charging you! no one has time to stare at their phone and not do anything else in fear of missing a response for God knows how long.

reviews.title: Subscription Cancellation not provided in the App or Website
reviews.text: Unlike some similar apps, JoyReels does not provide any easy cancellation options. I was noticed reoccurring charges on my account and after further investigation, I found out that the charges came from them. I tried to cancel through my Subscription Settings in Apple but this app was not listed, so I contacted their support team. However, it was an absolute dead end and they did not resolve the issue, which lead me to waste hours trying to find other options. This was very frustrating as I only used this app once or twice, so please do not make the same mistake I did and do not waste your time on this app.

reviews.title: It’s a SCAM
reviews.text:
I cannot give it ZERO stars, hence giving ONE! 
I purchased coins for 9.99$, which supposed to be about 3000 including bonus! I watched ONE episode (worth 116 coins), AFTER buying the coins and after that episode my balance dropped to ZERO……. NOTHING remained!
I have been writing repeatedly to the ONLINE CUSTOMER SUPPORT, & I am told it will be escalated to Technical department and I will hear in 2 days! 6days have already passed (2+2+2days!) I just wrote there again and I am sure they will tell me to wait 2 more days! These guys must be good at scamming. Just collect 10$ per person, let them watch one episode & get away with it! The SAME has happened to me on another such App that ‘supposedly’ deals via COINS; & they did the same and told me I had used all 10$ in 2 episodes that probably lasted less than 5min! So, this is just a warning for everyone to AVOID IT if possible! If they reimburse my money/coins, then I can consider changing or UPDATING this review, but until that happens; it is a SCAM for me! You have been WARNED!

reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text: Leave the app feeling scammed. I tried to tsk the math so I can purchase enough credits to watch one story in full (otherwise it takes forever to build enough coins to see more than a couple scenes). And at first it tells me each “chapter” is 88 coins so I purchase enough to watch the rest only to run out halfway and then suddenly each “chapter” now costs up to 126 coins! It’s frustrating and ruins the storylines. I subscribed hoping it would help, but it m barely made a difference. I will be canceling my subscription and deleting the app. There’s plenty of other options where a subscription is worth it.

reviews.title: Predatory subscription
reviews.text: If you choose to do a weekly subscription, GO THROUGH YOUR APPLE ACCOUNT! They won’t let me discontinue my subscription. They told me there should be an option to do it in my account settings, but neither the app nor the webpage has an option to do that. I messaged them and got a very helpful bot despite them saying it was a live agent. When I asked to speak to an actual live agent they stopped responding. So now I’m going through PayPal and my bank to stop it. And their content is lower quality and pretty lame compared to some of the other apps. Or you can just watch most of them on Dailymotion

reviews.title: No Customer Service
reviews.text: The app works fine, you have access to many different dramas however, their customer service does not exist.  There is an online customer service which is just a chat bot and when it can’t help you, it says it will escalate you to a specialist but it never connects you.  I have tried for weeks and different times of the day, night and early morning and still nothing!!

reviews.title: Her Final Chapter
reviews.text: Yet again takes my money but refuses to acknowledge it and won’t let me watch how can you pay £35 and still not be able to watch a complete series.  Can watch as many as I want in other apps for far less.  Just a nasty scam Company!

reviews.title: Took two payments won’t give it back
reviews.text: I paid for the VIP I had two payments won’t taken. I also somehow ended up with my subscription going through PayPal. I’ve tried their chat not that said it will put me through to their expert team that was five days ago and again today the chat bot said the same thing. I can’t get to a real person and the PayPal subscription is a nightmare to cancel as cancelling in PayPal it just says pending approval? From who? I should be able to cancel it and the chat bot can’t do it it’s not showing In any screen and I still haven’t had my refund for the two payments you already took… one should at least be given back. It’s looking more and more like a scam the more this goes on

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: This app is stupid it has good movies but they want you to keep spending money to watch it it has way to many adds it’s so much they let you watch until you have to keep paying to watch the other parts of the movie and I’m not about to keep paying for 5 minutes then have to pay again and the coins smh you have to sit through add after adds to get the free five minutes just to keep watching another 3 minutes of the movie

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: I caved like a dummy because I was bored and sucked into one of their really bad stories. I paid for a weekly subscription against my better judgment and was shocked when the show I was watching cut off after only 10 minutes, asking for MORE money to continue watching. I was livid that I was scammed, but decided to watch ads so I could at least find out what happened only to discover that even the “ads”required sketchy downloads in order to receive credits. The cous de gras was when I gave up and deleted the app only to discover that the “weekly subscription” I paid for was set up to auto renewed. Needless to say that was corrected and the app is gone. Consider this a warning. If you see an ad for a show on this app, scroll away before you get sucked in because they’ll definitely scam you.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: £20 spent and you can’t even watch a full show. There are far better apps out there this one is the worst by far.

reviews.title: Pay to have to pay again
reviews.text: Don’t be fooled to buy a subscription. You can’t even watch one full series with the subscription. It is not an unlimited subscription like many others. It gives you coins and in order to watch a whole series you have to buy more coins or watch adds. What a waste of money. I could have watched a couple of box office movie for the cost of a subscription that won’t even let me watch one series. I will not be renewing, i won’t be made a joke of the second time.
